name: Planar Infusion — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Planar Infusion from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Planar Infusions" but are not part of the Planar Infusion entry, which is unchanged. Sources named on the page for these sections: BoMT v3.

Material Plane (3pp)

Source BoMT v3

With the shattered worlds bleeding different realities into each other, many creatures have found themselves on worlds that feel like their own material plane, but which is fundamentally different. Such creatures can benefit from living in the different reality as if it were another plane entirely.

Basic Your features and speech patterns change in subtle ways to indicate your adaptation to the new world’s planar aspects, becoming more or less exaggerated. You gain a +2 bonus on Disguise and Linguistics checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in either of these skills, the bonus in that skill increases to +4.

Improved You have gained a better understanding of the creatures on this world, which allows you to better manipulate them. Once per day, you can use charm monster as a spell-like ability.

Greater Your adaptation to the plane is near-perfect, and your understanding of its differences gives you a previously undiscovered edge. You become an outsider with the native subtype (you still benefit from feats, spells, and effects as your original type, if you choose) and immediately gain skill ranks equal to your character level. Whenever you obtain a new character level, you gain 1 additional skill rank.
